title: Your 'Set and Forget' Portfolio Is Drifting — $46K Gone
hook: You set up auto-invest and walked away — but your portfolio's been quietly drifting for years, and nobody told you what that costs.
angle: Portfolio rebalancing is the most ignored but highest-impact 15-minute task in personal finance — Vanguard proved it adds $46K over 30 years
audience: Anyone who set up investing years ago and hasn't touched their allocation since
key_numbers: 0.35% extra annual return from annual rebalancing (Vanguard)
60/40 portfolio drifts to ~76/24 in 10 years without rebalancing
$46,000 more over 30 years on a $200K starting portfolio
